LanguageData.Chemfuel.label: chemfuel
LanguageData.Chemfuel.description:
A volatile liquid chemical. Used to fuel engines, or to transmute into propellant for projectiles, or as an incendiary weapon.

Stats as gravship fuel:
 - Fuel efficiency: <color=#ce0000>50%</color>
 - Chance to cause problems: <color=#ce0000>+50%</color>
LanguageData.OxidizedChemfuel.description:
A volatile liquid chemical with an oxidizer for orbital use. Used to fuel rockets. Extreme caution is required when handling.

Stats as gravship fuel:
 - Fuel efficiency: <color=#4bd12e>100%</color>
 - Chance to cause problems: <color=#4bd12e>-50%</color>
